info.title: collector-outputs
info.description: The outputs a relay sends a collector to store. The requirements in v1.md are the contract; this file describes the paths, methods, headers, bodies and statuses they state.

servers.description: The base URL the claim names; http://collector.tunnel selects the tunnel (COLLOUT-3, COLLOUT-4).

session.description: The session's collector token, where it has one (COLLOUT-5, COLLOUT-7, COLLOUT-9).

Unauthorized.description: The session's token is missing or wrong.

put.description: Streams the bytes of an artifact the build posted under name. The name is a slash path of several segments, each percent-encoded (COLLOUT-11, COLLOUT-12, COLLOUT-14).

schema.description: The bytes of the output, streamed.

400.description: The name is not an artifact's name; nothing is stored.

413.description: The body exceeds one of the collector's limits; nothing of it is stored where COLLOUT-30 says so.

5XX.description: The collector has not stored the output, for a reason of its own.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The artifact's name: a safe name whose segments start and end with a letter or a digit (COLLOUT-14). It spans path segments.

put.description: A payload the relay captured, sent with no length in advance and with the request trailer Warden-Hash, declared in the Trailer header field; the trailer follows the body and so is not a header this file can describe: the BLAKE2b-256 of the body as 64 hexadecimal digits (COLLOUT-15, COLLOUT-17, COLLOUT-18). The collector stores it under the name with every byte outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] replaced by _ (COLLOUT-16).

schema.description: The bytes of the output, streamed.

400.description: The name is empty, longer than 255 bytes or made only of dots; nothing is stored.

413.description: The body exceeds one of the collector's limits; nothing of it is stored where COLLOUT-30 says so.

5XX.description: The collector has not stored the output, for a reason of its own.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The capture's name, as the relay made it (COLLOUT-16).

parameters.name: Trailer
parameters.description: Declares the trailer Warden-Hash, which the relay sends (COLLOUT-18) and a collector reads when it is declared (COLLOUT-15).

put.description: One request for the whole build, its body the ledger as the relay writes it (COLLOUT-19, COLLOUT-26). The reply comes once the body has ended.

schema.description: The bytes of the output, streamed.

413.description: The body exceeds one of the collector's limits; nothing of it is stored where COLLOUT-30 says so.

5XX.description: The collector has not stored the output, for a reason of its own.

put.description: The payload of the ledger's environment record, at most 1 MiB, sent with no Content-Type (COLLOUT-20, COLLOUT-27, COLLOUT-31).

schema.description: The environment payload's bytes, at most 1 MiB.

413.description: The body exceeds one of the collector's limits; nothing of it is stored where COLLOUT-30 says so.

5XX.description: The collector has not stored the output, for a reason of its own.

post.description: A piece of the build's console, kept in the order the requests arrive (COLLOUT-21).

schema.description: The bytes of the output, streamed.

413.description: The body exceeds one of the collector's limits; nothing of it is stored where COLLOUT-30 says so.

5XX.description: The collector has not stored the output, for a reason of its own.
